name: DID Adventure ~Haikoujou kara no Dasshutsu~
original_name: DIDアドベンチャー ～廃工場からの脱出～
source:
A simple escape RPG themed on damsels in distress! Step into the shoes of protagonist Mio, who has been confined in an old abandoned factory by a mysterious girl named Michelle. Can Mio escape her predicament!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ362410.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
